# temps_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by `id` or `slug`. Needs the `projects:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "temps_project" "web" {
  slug = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric project ID.
- `slug` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `git_url` (String) Repository clone URL.
- `main_branch` (String) Production branch.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `preset` (String) Build preset.
- `source_type` (String) Source type.
